title: Imagine Image 2.0 adds precise edits, multi-image references and smart resizing
friendlyTitle: Grok gets better tools for making and editing images
summary: xAI has made Imagine Image 2.0 generally available in Grok’s web and mobile products. The release adds region-specific editing, background removal, up to five reference images, smart resizing and templates, while API access is still forthcoming.
friendlySummary: xAI’s new image tool can change one part of a picture, remove backgrounds, use up to five reference pictures and resize an image for different formats. It is available on Grok’s website and mobile apps.
whyItMatters: The update turns image generation into a more iterative production workflow rather than a one-shot novelty. Designers, marketers and small businesses can revise assets with less manual compositing, although xAI’s benchmark claims should still be tested on real projects.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can save time when making posters, product pictures or social media graphics. Try it on your own work before deciding how well it fits your needs.
